text: The urine tests and blood work have come back; please tell me if your results showed white blood cells, bacteria, or a low white blood cell count, and confirm if you have noticed increased urinary frequency or burning. Based on your recent antibiotic history and current symptoms, I suspect you may have developed a secondary infection despite the rash. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis results and CBC results.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis shows leukocyturia present and bacterial culture negative. CBC results are normal. You have reported symptoms of fatigue, fever, and flank pain, but no specific increase in urinary frequency or burning was noted in the provided history.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis. The presence of leukocyturia, fever, flank pain, and fatigue in the context of recent antibiotic treatment strongly supports an ascending urinary tract infection that has reached the kidneys.
